nodes.label: Prepare help article
nodes.rationale: The Prepare tab of a song's page is for getting it ready to mix. Front matter: tour prepare, order 7, keywords for scrub, vinyl, grid, cue, loop, tap, metronome, engine dj, rekordbox, traktor.

nodes.label: Scrubbing like vinyl (help)
nodes.rationale: Dragging the waveform sounds like a record under the hand, faster, slower, forwards or backwards, pitch following, no clicks. Let go while playing and it spins back up to tempo; let go while paused and it slows to a stop so a cue can be found by ear. A long song takes a moment to get ready; until then dragging just moves along.

nodes.label: Beat grid (help)
nodes.rationale: GLUE sets the BPM and first beat, checked with the metronome (M). Half and double tempo fixed with divide by 2 and times 2; Tap (T) taps it along; the grid moves earlier or later (shift for finer steps). Each profile can show BPMs as detected, folded into 60-120 or 120-240.

nodes.label: Cues and loops (help)
nodes.rationale: Cue points and loops are set on the waveform and show in the overview above.

nodes.label: In your DJ apps (help)
nodes.rationale: Under the cues, In your DJ apps shows each DJ library's hot cues, memory cues, loops and beat grid for the song. Use its cues replaces GLUE's cues; Use its grid takes its BPM and first beat. The main DJ library's grid and cues are the song's without a click (Make it main); setting a pad then makes them GLUE's own. With the main Engine DJ library kept in step both ways, changes go into Engine DJ when it is closed; a song changed in both shows Keep GLUE's or Keep Engine DJ's.
